enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on tap. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off tap. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Fry eggs. Turn off stove. Open cabinet. Take out plate. Place eggs on plate. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out glass. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat eggs. Drink milk. Stand up. Wash dishes. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Open drawer. Take out socks. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open bag. Put laptop in bag. Put notebook in bag. Close bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus arrives at stop. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Walk to elevator. Press button. Wait for elevator. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to office. Open office door.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, coordinating community programs
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email program. Read emails. Type replies. Make phone calls. Write notes. Attend meeting. Discuss programs. Return to desk. Open files. Review documents. Make schedule. Print documents. File documents. Stand up. Walk to printer. Pick up printouts. Walk back to desk. Sit down. Continue typing.

Walk to cafeteria. Stand in line. Order food. Pay for food. Carry tray to table. Sit down. Pick up fork. Eat food. Drink water. Talk with colleague. Finish eating. Stand up. Throw away trash. Return tray. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, meeting community partners and planning events
enriched_activities.desc: Meet community partners. Shake hands. Sit in meeting room. Discuss event plans. Take notes. Use computer. Print agenda. Distribute copies. Make phone calls. Send emails. Update calendar. Stand up. Walk to colleague's desk. Discuss logistics. Return to desk. Type report. Save file. Close computer.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus arrives at stop. Get off bus. Walk to home. Enter building. Walk to apartment door. Unlock door. Open door. Enter home. Close door.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Cut vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Cook. Turn off stove. Open cabinet. Take out plate. Serve food.
Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat food. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Pick up napkin. Wipe mouth. Continue eating. Finish meal. Stand up. Clear table. Wash dishes. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying up and vacuuming the living room
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up items from floor. Put items in drawer. Open closet. Take out vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum. Turn on vacuum. Vacuum floor. Turn off vacuum. Unplug vacuum. Put vacuum away. Close closet.
Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch program. Adjust volume. Put down remote. Continue watching. Pick up remote. Change channel. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer with the desk lamp to review next day's program schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Open program schedule. Read schedule. Make notes. Type updates. Save file. Close computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Brushing teeth and washing up before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading with the desk lamp to wind down
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Continue reading. Close book. Turn off desk lamp.
Lie in bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep.
